purpose.domain_detail: Car rental management system processing rental requests, rejections, and statistics for a vehicle fleet
purpose.summary: This program (TRABAJO PRACTICO NRO. 1) processes car rental requests from three input solicitation files (SOL1, SOL2, SOL3) and an existing rentals file (ALQ), merging them by key (patente/date), writing accepted rentals to an output file, rejected records to a rejections file, and producing a printed listing and statistics by car brand and month.

notable_features: Multiple sequential file merge (3-way solicitation merge with ALQ)
OCCURS table for cars (300 entries) and statistics (100 brands x 12 months)
88-level condition names for file status checking
HIGH-VALUES used as sentinel for end-of-file
INDEXED BY clause on OCCURS table
Windows-style backslash paths in ASSIGN clauses
PROGRAM-ID with quoted string containing spaces
verdict.notes: Program name is 'TRABAJO PRACTICO NRO. 1' (Spanish for 'Practical Assignment No. 1'), strongly indicating a university student exercise. Source is truncated at 16000 chars; the PROCEDURE DIVISION is incomplete. Mixed indentation with tabs visible in the source. The PROGRAM-ID uses a quoted string with spaces which is non-standard but supported by RM-COBOL.
